normalize_text_simplify: normalize text by lowercasing, removing punctuation, normalizing numbers and whitespace, and stripping diacritics
split_text_into_sentences: split text into sentences using a language-aware word tokenizer
split_text_into_words: split text into words using a language-aware word tokenizer
split_text_into_paragraphs: split text into paragraphs preserving line breaks between paragraphs
generate_ngrams: generate n-grams from an iterable sequence of tokens
